name: Fortune Sunflower Oil
description: Refined sunflower oil with a light taste for everyday frying, sauteing and tadka. Store away from heat and sunlight with the cap closed.

name: Freedom Sunflower Oil
description: Refined sunflower oil for frying, curries and baking. Keep in a cool, dark cupboard and avoid reusing oil many times.

name: Fortune Groundnut Oil
description: Groundnut oil with a mild nutty flavour for South Indian and Gujarati cooking and deep frying. Store tightly capped away from heat.

name: Dhara Groundnut Oil
description: Groundnut oil for tempering, frying pakoras and everyday sabzi. Keep the bottle closed in a cool place to preserve flavour.

name: Fortune Mustard Oil
description: Kachi ghani mustard oil with a sharp aroma for pickles, Bengali fish curry and North Indian tadka. Heat until it just smokes before cooking.

name: Dhara Mustard Oil
description: Pungent mustard oil for achar, sarson da saag and everyday cooking in eastern and northern India. Store away from direct sunlight.

name: Fortune Rice Bran Oil
description: Rice bran oil with a neutral taste and high smoke point for deep frying and everyday curries. Keep capped in a cool cupboard.

name: Saffola Rice Bran Oil
description: Rice bran based cooking oil for frying, sauteing and tadka. Check the label for the exact oil blend and store away from heat.

name: Parachute Coconut Oil
description: Pure coconut oil that solidifies below about 24 C. Used in Kerala-style cooking and for tempering; warm the bottle in water to melt it.

name: KLF Coconad Coconut Oil
description: Edible coconut oil for avial, thoran, fish curry and frying banana chips. Store at room temperature; it may turn solid in cool weather.

name: Idhayam Sesame Oil
description: Gingelly oil for South Indian tempering, pickles and podi rice. Keep the bottle closed in a cool, dark place.

name: Anveshan Sesame Oil
description: Wood-pressed sesame oil with a deep, nutty aroma for tadka, chutneys and pickles. Store away from sunlight; some settling is natural.

name: Figaro Olive Oil
description: Olive oil for light sauteing, roasting vegetables and Mediterranean dishes. Keep tightly capped away from heat and light.

name: Borges Olive Oil
description: Imported olive oil for salad dressings, pasta and gentle cooking. Store in a cool cupboard and use within a few months of opening.

name: Saffola Blended Oil
description: A blended edible oil combining two vegetable oils for everyday cooking and frying. See the label for the blend ratio; store away from heat.

name: Fortune Blended Oil
description: Multi-source blended cooking oil for curries, stir-fries and frying. Keep the pack sealed and away from direct sunlight.

name: Amul Ghee
description: Clarified butter for tadka, rotis, dal and Indian sweets. Store at room temperature with the lid closed and use a dry spoon.

name: Gowardhan Ghee
description: Desi ghee with a rich aroma for halwa, laddoos, biryani and drizzling over hot rice. Keep tightly closed away from moisture.

name: Anveshan Bilona Ghee
description: Ghee made by the bilona method of churning curd into butter and slowly heating it. Grainy texture is natural; store at room temperature.

name: Two Brothers Organic Farms Bilona Ghee
description: Traditionally churned bilona ghee from a farm producer, for rotis, dal and sweets. Use a clean, dry spoon and keep the jar closed.

name: Amul Cow Ghee
description: Ghee made from cow milk, pale yellow with a mild flavour, for everyday cooking and sweets. Store in a cool place with the lid shut.

name: Gowardhan Cow Ghee
description: Cow ghee for tadka, parathas and festive sweets. Solidifies in cold weather, which does not affect quality; keep away from moisture.

name: Akshayakalpa A2 Cow Ghee
description: Cow ghee sold by the producer as A2, made from milk of its partner farms. Use for cooking or on hot rice; store sealed at room temperature.

name: Anveshan A2 Cow Ghee
description: Producer-labelled A2 cow ghee with a granular texture, for rotis, dal and sweets. Keep the jar tightly closed and use a dry spoon.

name: Everest Turmeric Powder
description: Ground turmeric for curries, dals and marinades. A small pinch gives colour and earthy flavour; store in an airtight jar away from light.

name: MDH Red Chilli Powder
description: Ground red chilli for heat and colour in curries, chutneys and marinades. Keep the pack sealed and away from humidity.

name: Everest Garam Masala
description: A ground blend of warm spices to add at the end of cooking curries, dals and biryani. Store airtight to keep the aroma.

name: MDH Kitchen King Masala
description: An all-purpose spice blend for mixed vegetable sabzis, paneer and dal. Add while sauteing onions and tomatoes; keep the box closed.

name: Aachi Sambar Powder
description: Ground spice blend for South Indian sambar with toor dal and vegetables. Add with tamarind water and simmer; store in a dry jar.

name: MTR Rasam Powder
description: Spice powder for tangy rasam with tamarind, tomato and pepper. Add a spoon to boiling rasam and simmer briefly; keep the pack sealed.

name: Everest Chicken Masala
description: Ground spice blend for home-style chicken curry. Add after browning onions with ginger-garlic paste; store airtight after opening.

name: Aachi Chicken Masala
description: Chicken masala powder for South Indian style chicken curry, fry and chukka. Marinate or add during cooking; keep the pouch sealed.

name: Everest Mutton Masala
description: Spice blend for mutton curry and keema, with whole-spice flavours ground together. Add while cooking the meat; store in a dry place.

name: Aachi Mutton Masala
description: Masala powder for mutton curry, fry and kuzhambu. Use with onion, tomato and coconut as you like; reseal the pouch after use.

name: Aachi Fish Masala
description: Spice blend for fish curry and fish fry. Mix with tamarind for curry, or coat fish pieces with masala and salt before shallow frying.

name: Eastern Fish Masala
description: Kerala-style fish masala for curries and fry. Coat fish with masala, salt and a little water and rest 15 minutes before cooking.

name: Everest Biryani Masala
description: Spice blend for layered chicken, mutton or vegetable biryani. Add to the marinade or gravy base; store airtight to keep the aroma.

name: Shan Biryani Masala
description: Recipe mix for biryani with chicken, mutton or prawns. It contains salt, so taste before adding more; follow the recipe on the box.

name: Shan Tandoori Masala
description: Spice mix for marinating chicken, fish or paneer for tandoori dishes. Mix with yogurt and lemon, marinate for a few hours and grill or bake.

name: Everest Tandoori Chicken Masala
description: Masala for tandoori chicken and tikka marinades. Combine with curd, ginger-garlic paste and oil; rest the meat before grilling.

name: Tata Salt
description: Vacuum-evaporated iodised salt for everyday cooking and the table. Keep in a dry container with a lid to prevent caking.

name: Aashirvaad Salt
description: Iodised table salt for cooking, pickling and seasoning. Store in a dry, closed jar away from the stove.

name: Madhur Sugar
description: Refined white sugar for tea, coffee, desserts and baking. Keep in an airtight container to stop it clumping or attracting ants.

name: Dhampur Sugar
description: Crystal white sugar for chai, sweets and everyday cooking. Store in a dry jar with a tight lid.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Jaggery
description: Organic jaggery block from sugarcane for chikki, payasam and gur wali chai. Break into pieces as needed and keep wrapped in a dry jar.

name: Organic Tattva Jaggery
description: Unrefined organic jaggery for sweets, chutneys and tea. Store airtight; it may soften in humid weather, which is normal.

name: Sugar Free Sugar Substitute
description: Low-calorie sweetener pellets to use in place of sugar in tea and coffee. Check the pack for how many pellets equal a spoon of sugar.

name: Equal Sugar Substitute
description: Single-serve sweetener sachets to stir into hot or cold drinks. Keep sachets dry and see the box for usage guidance.

name: Tata Sampann Cumin Seeds
description: Whole cumin for tadka in dals, jeera rice and raita. Splutter in hot oil or ghee, or dry-roast and grind; store airtight.

name: Catch Mustard Seeds
description: Small black mustard seeds for South Indian tempering, pickles and kasundi. Let them pop in hot oil before adding other ingredients.

name: Catch Cloves
description: Whole cloves for biryani, garam masala and chai. Use sparingly as the flavour is strong; store in a tightly closed jar.

name: Everest Cinnamon
description: Cinnamon sticks for pulao, biryani, curries and masala chai. Add whole to hot oil or grind fresh; keep away from moisture.

name: Star Anise
description: Loose star-shaped whole spice with a liquorice-like aroma, used in biryani and garam masala. Store whole in an airtight jar.

name: Bay Leaf
description: Dried Indian bay leaves (tej patta) for pulao, dal and curries. Add whole to hot oil at the start and remove before serving.

name: Kalonji
description: Loose nigella seeds for naan, pickles, panch phoron and Bengali dishes. Store in a closed jar away from light.

name: Aachi Dry Red Chilli
description: Whole dried red chillies for tempering, chutneys and grinding into masala. Remove seeds for less heat; store in an airtight container.

name: Eastern Dry Turmeric
description: Dried whole turmeric fingers for grinding fresh haldi powder at home or for pickles. Keep dry; grind in small batches.

name: Dabur Hommade Ginger Garlic Paste
description: Ready ginger-garlic paste for curries, marinades and biryani. Saute in oil until the raw smell goes; refrigerate after opening.

name: Mother's Recipe Ginger Garlic Paste
description: Ginger-garlic paste for everyday sabzis, chicken and paneer dishes. Use a clean, dry spoon and keep refrigerated once opened.

name: Kissan Tomato Puree
description: Smooth tomato puree for gravies, pasta sauce and soups. Saves chopping fresh tomatoes; refrigerate and use within a few days of opening.

name: Del Monte Tomato Puree
description: Tomato puree for makhani gravy, pizza sauce and soups. Shake or stir before use and store the opened pack in the fridge.

name: Dabur Hommade Tamarind Paste
description: Ready tamarind paste for sambar, rasam, chutneys and chaat. Saves soaking and straining imli; refrigerate after opening.

name: Mother's Recipe Green Chilli Paste
description: Green chilli paste for adding heat to dals, chutneys and marinades. Start with a small amount; keep refrigerated once opened.

name: MTR Paneer Gravy Mix
description: Instant gravy mix for paneer dishes; mix with water, simmer and add paneer cubes. Store in a cool, dry place.

name: Gits Makhani Gravy Mix
description: Ready mix for a buttery tomato makhani gravy to use with paneer, vegetables or chicken. Follow the pack directions for water quantity.

name: Keya Oregano
description: Dried oregano leaves for pizza, pasta and garlic bread. Crush between your fingers to release the aroma; keep the jar tightly closed.

name: Catch Basil Leaves
description: Dried basil leaves for pasta sauces, soups and salad dressings. Add towards the end of cooking and store away from heat.

name: Keya Italian Seasoning
description: A dried herb mix for pasta, pizza, roasted vegetables and dips. Sprinkle while cooking or over finished dishes; keep the jar sealed.

name: Catch Mixed Herbs
description: Mixed dried herbs for soups, sauces, marinades and garlic butter. Store in a cool, dry place away from steam.

name: Keya Chilli Flakes
description: Crushed red chilli flakes to sprinkle on pizza, pasta, eggs and noodles. Keep the jar closed to retain heat and colour.

name: Catch Black Pepper Powder
description: Ground black pepper for eggs, soups, salads and rasam. Use as a table seasoning or in cooking; store airtight.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Turmeric Powder
description: Certified organic ground turmeric for dals, curries and pickles. Store in an airtight jar away from light and moisture.

name: Organic Tattva Chilli Powder
description: Organic red chilli powder for curries, chutneys and marinades. Adjust quantity to taste and keep the pack sealed.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Black Pepper
description: Organic whole black peppercorns for rasam, pepper chicken and fresh grinding. Use a grinder for best aroma; store airtight.

name: Organic Tattva Cumin Seeds
description: Organic whole cumin for tadka, jeera rice and spice blends. Dry-roast and grind for raita and chaat; keep in a sealed jar.

name: Anveshan Coconut Oil
description: Wood-pressed coconut oil for Kerala-style cooking and tempering. Solidifies in cool weather; warm gently to liquefy before use.

name: Akshayakalpa Cow Ghee
description: Cow ghee from an organic dairy farm producer, for rotis, dal and sweets. Store at room temperature with the lid closed.
